 2026 Players Era 8: Bracket, schedule, scores
 2026-27 NCAA men's basketball top 25 season preview 
 Share 
 The 2026 Players Era Men’s Championship has expanded once again, this time to 24 teams, with traditional bracket play and a true championship format. This year’s competition is split into two events in consecutive weeks — Players Era 8 and Players Era 16. 
 First up, the Players Era 8.
 The Players Era 8 will see eight of the nation’s top programs face off in Las Vegas from Nov. 17-19. Three ranked teams highlight the field, including top-ranked Florida. Every team except Auburn is undefeated heading into the tournament.
 The eight teams will take the court on Tuesday, Nov. 17, followed by the semifinals on Wednesday, Nov. 18. The competition wraps up with the championship game on Thursday, Nov. 19. Each team will play three games, regardless of its results.
 Players Era 8: Schedule, scores, how to watch
 All times are in ET. Games are at Michelob ULTRA Arena and broadcast on ESPN/ESPN2. 
 Tuesday, Nov. 17 
 2 p.m. | No. 8 Houston vs. Rutgers | ESPN 
 4:30 p.m. | No. 1 Florida vs. Notre Dame | ESPN 
 9:30 p.m. | No. 15 Kansas vs. UNLV | ESPN 
 12 a.m. | Auburn vs. West Virginia | ESPN 
 Wednesday, Nov. 18:  Semifinals
 Thursday, Nov. 19: Championship
 Players Era 8 bracket:
 Player's Era history:
 This is the third year of the Players Era Festival, and six of the teams slated to play this week have competed in the past. However, this is the first year to feature traditional bracket play. The 2024 and 2025 Players Era Festivals featured pre-set matchups that determined final seeding.
 Florida and West Virginia will make their Players Era debut, while Houston, Rutgers and Notre Dame compete for the third year in a row.
